name: openjdk-helper
description: Explore OpenJDK contributors, JBS issues, JEPs, reviews, backports and contribution processes.
long_description: Twenty-seven read-only tools provide census memberships and freshness, JBS issue search with structured filters, fix-status across backports, JEP lookup and search, JDK release schedules, GitHub repositories and pull requests, Skara review evidence with reviewer roles, pull request triage, contributor records, activity summaries, commit-based backport searches, mailing list archive search, Developers' Guide excerpts, repository contribution/build guidance, and project-lead processes with governing sources. The server runs locally over stdio without a Java installation. Public OpenJDK and GitHub access requires no account; optional tokens can be configured where supported. JBS access restrictions are reported explicitly, and access depends on upstream policy.

tools.name: getVersion
tools.description: Get the running OpenJDK Helper version.

tools.name: searchPeople
tools.description: Search contributors in the OpenJDK census.

tools.name: getPerson
tools.description: Get a contributor's census entry and memberships.

tools.name: searchProjects
tools.description: Search OpenJDK census projects.

tools.name: getProject
tools.description: Get an OpenJDK census project.

tools.name: searchGroups
tools.description: Search OpenJDK census groups.

tools.name: getGroup
tools.description: Get an OpenJDK census group.

tools.name: getProjectMembers
tools.description: Page project members by exact census role and optional name filter.

tools.name: getCensusStatus
tools.description: Inspect census source, publication, refresh and stale status.

tools.name: getGitHubRepos
tools.description: Page public repositories for a GitHub organization.

tools.name: getGitHubPulls
tools.description: Page repository pull requests with descriptions, labels and provenance.

tools.name: getOpenJdkReview
tools.description: Inspect Skara progress, reviews, checks and JBS links for a pull request.

tools.name: getBackportStatus
tools.description: Find bounded commit-provenance evidence in selected update repositories.

tools.name: getPullRequestTriage
tools.description: Group open pull requests by Skara state: ready, awaiting review, blocked, CSR, conflicts, stale, drafts.

tools.name: getContributorRecord
tools.description: Count a contributor's integrated, open and abandoned pull requests for nominations.

tools.name: getProjectActivity
tools.description: Summarize integrated pull requests, authors and first-time contributors in a period.

tools.name: getIssue
tools.description: Read a JBS issue, versions and linked CSR/backport issues; report access failures.

tools.name: getIssueFixStatus
tools.description: List every linked backport with fix versions, summarized as fixedIn and pendingIn releases.

tools.name: searchIssues
tools.description: Search JBS by literal text with exact project, status, type, version, component, priority, assignee, resolution and date filters.

tools.name: getJep
tools.description: Read a published JEP's metadata, source links and bounded summary.

tools.name: searchJeps
tools.description: Search the official JEP index by title, number, status and release.

tools.name: getContributionContext
tools.description: Resolve repository contribution rules and census role candidates from source evidence.

tools.name: getBuildGuidance
tools.description: Read repository build/test documentation excerpts and optional ProblemList matches.

tools.name: getProjectProcesses
tools.description: Summarize project-lead duties, appointments, elections and contribution processes with governing links.

tools.name: getReleaseSchedule
tools.description: Read a JDK release's milestones, current phase, next milestone and targeted JEPs.

tools.name: searchMailingList
tools.description: List or search one month of an OpenJDK mailing list archive, classifying votes and review requests.

tools.name: searchDevelopersGuide
tools.description: Get verbatim section excerpts from the OpenJDK Developers' Guide.
